task_text: I woke up late and have to leave for work in 10 minutes. I need something quick to eat, and the living room should be tidy so I can grab my things and go.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a quick meal by slicing and pouring ingredients, then pass the meal to R2.
central_instructions.R2: Receive the prepared meal from R1 and bring it to the living room for R3.
central_instructions.R3: Receive the meal from R2 and ensure it is ready for consumption.
central_instructions.R4: Tidy up the living room by picking up any objects and pushing furniture into place.

agent_plans.R1:
